title: tot-app.json
description: Declarative manifest for a Storefront Private App. Describes an app's identity, the least-privilege scopes it requests, the events it subscribes to, the sandboxed widget slots it may occupy, and (for the optional ToT-hosted runtime) its egress allowlist. The manifest is per-app and language-neutral; it never binds a tenant — install records do that. Contract version 1 (semver).

contractVersion.description: Major version of the Private Apps contract this manifest targets. This file documents v1.

id.description: Stable, globally-unique app id in reverse-DNS-ish form. Immutable across versions.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in admin install/health UI.

version.description: App version, semver. Distinct from contractVersion.

owner.description: The party responsible for the app (agency, merchant team, or partner).

installMode.description: Where the app runs. 'external' apps are self-hosted and reach the gateway over the public contract. 'hosted' is platform-managed; availability and setup are outside this public contract. The same manifest shape applies to both.

scopes.description: Least-privilege scopes the app requests at install time. Constrained to the V1 catalog; unknown or forbidden scope strings are rejected. See scopes.json.

webhooks.description: Event subscriptions and the endpoint that receives them. Requires the matching read scope (e.g. order topics require orders:webhook).

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that receives signed CloudEvents. Must be https.

signatureKeyId.description: Optional keyid the app expects in the HTTP Message Signature 'Signature-Input'. If omitted, the gateway advertises the active keyid via its JWKS/signature-metadata endpoint.

widgets.description: Sandboxed widget placements the app requests. Requires the widgets:launch scope. Placements are limited to the platform-owned slots; widgets render in a platform-managed sandboxed iframe, never as merchant-pasted script.

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that serves the sandboxed widget's content. Must be https.

title.description: Label shown near the widget in admin placement controls.

adminLinks.description: Deep links surfaced in the Storefront admin app-detail view (e.g. the app's own dashboard). Informational only; they never confer platform authority.

telemetryMode.description: How much OpenTelemetry the gateway retains for this app's traffic. 'errors-only' keeps failing/denied spans; 'sampled' keeps a sampled slice; 'full' keeps every span (higher cost).

retention.description: Data-retention policy for delivery logs and any app-scoped operational records the platform keeps on the app's behalf.

eventLogDays.description: Days the platform retains webhook delivery records for this install.

piiRedaction.description: 'default' redacts sensitive payload bodies from admin health; 'strict' additionally minimizes any optional identifiers to opaque ids/hashes.

hosting.description: Optional. Present only for the ToT-hosted runtime (installMode: hosted). Ignored for external apps.

image.description: Container image reference for the hosted runtime.

allowedHosts.description: Egress allowlist. Default egress is deny-all; only these hosts are reachable from the container, and unknown hosts are denied and logged.
